summary.text: Larry Betts is the Working Class Party candidate for Michigan State Senate District 2 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the party's June 6, 2026 convention.
He has appeared on Michigan general election ballots as a Working Class Party candidate in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Betts was the Working Class Party candidate for Michigan State Senate District 5 in 2018, receiving 4.4% of the vote in a general election won by Betty Jean Alexander.
He advanced from the party's convention for Michigan House of Representatives District 15 in 2020, where incumbent Abdullah Hammoud won the general election.
In 2022 he ran for State Senate District 2, receiving 2.6% of the vote as incumbent Sylvia Santana won.
In 2024 he ran for Michigan House of Representatives District 3, receiving 4.4% of the vote as incumbent Alabas Farhat won.
